title: Community Health, Media & Systems 11

weeks.title: Social Determinants of Health
weeks.essential_question: How do housing, education, transportation, income, environment, and access influence health outcomes?

weeks.title: Health Equity & Access
weeks.essential_question: How can barriers affect communities differently, and what makes a response equitable?

weeks.title: Public Health Foundations
weeks.essential_question: How do prevention, surveillance, education, policy, and community systems protect populations?

weeks.title: Epidemiology Literacy
weeks.essential_question: How can rates, risk, correlation, and uncertainty be interpreted without overclaiming?

weeks.title: Environmental Health
weeks.essential_question: How do air, water, heat, built environments, and exposure pathways affect community health?

weeks.title: Occupational Health & Safety
weeks.essential_question: What responsibilities help reduce workplace injury and exposure?

weeks.title: Healthcare Systems & Insurance Literacy
weeks.essential_question: How do primary care, urgent/emergency care, insurance, deductibles, networks, and appeals fit together conceptually?

weeks.title: Medication & Label Literacy
weeks.essential_question: How can consumers read labels and use prescription/OTC resources responsibly without self-prescribing?

weeks.title: Midterm Skills Review
weeks.essential_question: Can I connect individual health choices to systems, access, and reliable evidence?

weeks.title: Media, Advertising & Health Claims
weeks.essential_question: How do persuasive techniques and sponsorship influence health information?

weeks.title: Nutrition & Supplement Claims
weeks.essential_question: How can nutrition and supplement claims be evaluated without treating marketing as medical evidence?

weeks.title: Fitness & Wellness Claims
weeks.essential_question: How can training, recovery, and wellness claims be checked against evidence and individual context?

weeks.title: Substance Use as a Public-Health Issue
weeks.essential_question: How can prevention, treatment access, stigma reduction, and policy affect community outcomes?

weeks.title: Mental-Health Systems & Access
weeks.essential_question: What roles do schools, community care, qualified professionals, emergency services, and support networks play?

weeks.title: Emergency Preparedness
weeks.essential_question: How can households and communities prepare for severe weather, disasters, outages, and public-health emergencies?

weeks.title: Community Resource Mapping
weeks.essential_question: How can a person identify credible local services without exposing private information?

weeks.title: Community Health Advocacy
weeks.essential_question: How can evidence support a practical community-health improvement proposal?

weeks.title: Final Portfolio & Reflection
weeks.essential_question: Can I evaluate a health-system problem using evidence, equity, access, and realistic solutions?

privacy_policy: No required disclosure of private medical, mental-health, trauma, sexuality, family medical history, or substance-use information.
medical_boundary: Educational health literacy only; not diagnosis or individualized treatment.
